name: Vinhos: Deluxe Edition

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the 3rd Fair (end of Year 6) plus one final action per player

categories.label: Victory points on score track
categories.hint: VP gained during play (exports, Fairs, wine tiles, etc.) shown on the VP track before final scoring.

categories.label: VP from money
categories.hint: Look up your Bagos total on the money table beside the player board (0-18 VP, in the rulebook final-scoring table)

categories.label: Half of wine quality (rounded down)
categories.labelVi: Một nửa chất lượng rượu (làm tròn xuống)
categories.hint: For each wine you still hold (Cellar/Warehouse) take quality/2 rounded down, sum them.

categories.label: Export Area column majorities
categories.labelVi: Đa số cột khu Xuất khẩu
categories.hint: Sum VP shown atop each column where you export the most; ties split points, rounded down.

categories.label: End-game Multiplier tiles (with barrel)
categories.hint: VP of each Multiplier tile that still has a barrel on it; tiles without a barrel score 0. See Reference Book p.5.

categories.label: Barrels in Export Area (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Thùng ở khu Xuất khẩu (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Most barrels in the Export Area

notes: family: area-majority (export columns) + engine/economy. Final scoring is identical in the 2010 Reserve and 2016 Special Vintage rulebooks. The money-to-VP table is a printed graphic, so VP from money is entered directly (example: 6 Bagos = 3 VP, 14 = 7, 20/25 = 18). Column VP values are printed above the Export Area columns. Expansions and solo not modelled.
